# Synthetic ClassTab-style fixtures

**Every file here is authored by the Riffway authors** (TASKS.md D2). ClassTab.org publishes no
licence, so no ClassTab tab or MIDI is committed; these files only imitate its *house style*
(title line with life dates, `MIDI:` header URL, `tuning: … key: … time:` line, beat-ruler lines,
`=` sustains, `*` repeat dots, fingering lines under the staff, a trailing "Notes & Legend" section,
CRLF line endings, a windows-1252 file). Composers ("Ada Fictional", "Bérénice Exemple") and pieces
are invented.

The `.mid` files are generated by [`midi-fixtures.ts`](midi-fixtures.ts) with `@tonejs/midi` from
note lists that mirror the tabs; `tests/align/fixtures.test.ts` rebuilds them and compares bytes.
Regenerate with `npx tsx tests/fixtures/classtab-synthetic/midi-fixtures.ts --write`.

| Tab | MIDI | Pairing rule | Rhythm | Exercises |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `riffway_study_no1_in_e.txt` | `riffway_study_no1_in_e.mid` | basename | `midi` (else `ruler`) | 6/8 with a one-eighth pickup, hammer-on, sustains, Notes & Legend example staff (skipped); the MIDI starts with a rest bar and adds an ornament the tab lacks |
| `riffway_waltz_in_a.txt` | `riffway_waltz_in_a_1.mid` | suffix | `ruler` (the MIDI is a different piece, < 80% match) | 3/4 ruler, `tempo: Q=90`, "6th string to D" prose with standard `E` labels, two-digit fret |
| `riffway_march_in_c.txt` | `riffway_marche_elegante.mid` | header URL | `midi` (else `ruler`) | windows-1252 text, 4/4 quarter-note ruler with eighths between marks, unlabelled second staff, `key - C    time - 4/4` |
| `riffway_two_preludes.txt` | `riffway_two_preludes_01.mid`, `_02.mid` | version | `midi` per version | two versions in one file, each with its own `MIDI:` header and Notes section |
| `riffway_lament_unpaired.txt` | — | none | `needs-alignment` | no MIDI and no ruler, "Tune 6th to D, capo 2" prose |
| — | `riffway_orphan_am.mid` | never paired | — | a MIDI without a tab |
